messages:
Priya Shah: Hey team — need a small asset set for next Tues: 1) social slice-card (static) 2) hero webinar slide (wide) 3) one-pager thumbnail (square). Goal: show inference economics across Hosted / Dedicated / Private in a single visual 'slice' — simple bar + callouts, with a tiny latency vs cost sparkline. Keep copy short.
Marta Lopez: got it. can you confirm which benchmark numbers to use? do we have canonical cost-per-token and median p95 latency per model tier? :thinking_face: @James Wu
James Wu: Use the 2/15 benchmark set we ran last quarter. quick numbers: Hosted median p95 = 120ms, cost = $0.0026/token; Dedicated p95 = 85ms, cost = $0.0019/token; Private p95 = 95ms, cost = $0.0021/token. I can drop the CSV to Drive.
Anika Rao: thanks — please share link + any preferred copy. Also: accessible color palette and contrast requirements? I’ll mock 3 comps (icon-led, split bar, and compact sparkline).
Priya Shah: short copy: headline "Inference economics: predictable performance, lower unit cost" Subhead for card: "Hosted • Dedicated • Private — pick the right tradeoff" CTA: "See benchmark details". Brand: use Core Blue + Neutral palette; follow WCAG AA for text over color.
Marta Lopez: @Anika can you aim for 1200x628 for social, 1920x1080 for webinar slide, 800x800 for thumbnail? Also include an editable Figma with layers named for copy and data.
Anika Rao: noted. rough ETA — initial thumbnails by EOD Thursday, full comps Friday morning. Do we need multi-language variants?
Sam Patel: we’ll only need EN for launch; localization later. Also point-of-contact for product questions is @James Wu. Priority: medium-high but blockers = legal review for any claims about "cost savings".
DesignBot: Automated check: use font Inter variable; set heading min-size 20px for thumbnail. Contrast check pending on final palette.
Marta Lopez: Legal — do we need a safe phrasing for the cost claim? e.g., "lower unit cost in our benchmarks" vs absolute savings?
Priya Shah: use "lower unit cost in our benchmarks" to avoid absolute guarantees. Legal sign-off not needed unless we change to absolute dollar savings.
James Wu: uploaded CSV and a short notes doc: /drive/redwood/marketing/benchmarks/Q4_inference_slice.csv — includes sample sizes and model config. Anika, please call out any numbers you plan to surface so I can sanity-check.
Anika Rao: will do. quick Q: do we want icons for each deployment type (cloud, rack, lock) or just text labels?
Priya Shah: icons would help. keep them minimal line icons.
Marta Lopez: tagging timeline — final assets due Monday COB for localization handoff. If we need faster review, ping me.
Priya Shah: thanks everyone — @Anika iterate on the 3 comps and drop Figma link when ready. I’ll prep the social post copy and coordinate webinar slide deck. :rocket:
DesignBot: Reminder: attach alt text for all images before export.
Anika Rao: got it — will add alt text and an editable legend layer.
